# yoshiki

> A library of design registers. Zone first (graphic vs text), roles instead of raw
> values, sixteen equal palettes as a swappable layer, and 246 components rebuilt from
> references and kept pure within fourteen stylistic registers. One register per design;
> never two in the same frame. AGENTS.md overrides any older wording in the modules below.

## Start here
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how to apply yoshiki — read order, the laws, the map
- [PHILOSOPHY.md](PHILOSOPHY.md): why it looks like this — kintsugi, tone & triggers, gold-gilding

## Principles — the defaults, what wins when nothing is specified
- [priority](canon/language/priority.md): the ordered ladder (higher rung wins)
- [defaults](canon/language/defaults.md): concrete fallbacks for every choice

## Palettes — sixteen variants in twelve families, one role contract
- [roles](canon/language/roles.md): the contract every palette answers — bg, border, text, bar, accent, signal
- [zones](canon/language/zones.md): graphic vs text — decide this before anything else
- [palette overview](canon/palettes/README.md): tokens vs roles, families, codes
- [Night beige](canon/palettes/night-beige/palette.yml): BE-N — the dark default
- [Beige glass](canon/palettes/beige-glass/palette.yml): BE-D — the light companion
- [the other fourteen](canon/palettes/): porcelain · concrete · yorha · blush(+night) · lab(+night) · hanko(+night) · cafe · ember · moss · signal · walnut
- [DTCG tokens](canon/palettes/night-beige/night-beige.tokens.json): W3C design tokens — Style Dictionary / agent readable
- [contrast proof](canon/palettes/CONTRAST.md): WCAG, regenerated on every build
- [accessibility](canon/palettes/ACCESSIBILITY.md): contrast + colour-blind safety — glyph, not colour alone

## Components — the anatomy of a control
- [components](canon/objects/graphic/README.md): the five shared laws, geometry, density
- [controls](canon/objects/graphic/controls.md): buttons, links, segmented — the edge is the affordance
- [forms](canon/objects/graphic/forms.md): field anatomy, inputs, choice, switch, range
- [surfaces](canon/objects/graphic/surfaces.md): card, panel, dialog, popover, divider
- [feedback](canon/objects/graphic/feedback.md): alert, toast, badge, status, progress, empty
- [data](canon/objects/graphic/data.md): table, list, key-value, tree, stat tile, charts

## Lexicon — the form of the language, apart from color
- [glyphs](canon/objects/text/glyphs.md): semantic symbols — one glyph, one meaning
- [nameplates](canon/objects/text/nameplates.md): spaced-capital seals
- [frames](canon/objects/text/frames.md): soft capsules ╭╮ vs hard spines ╔╠╚
- [space](canon/objects/text/space.md): rhythm, margin, tracking — Ma in practice
- [states](canon/objects/text/states.md): default · hover · focus · disabled · error
- [cli](canon/objects/text/cli.md): CLI / TUI canon — prompt, statuses, trees
- [comments](canon/objects/text/comments.md): code comments — frames + meaning-marks
- [messaging](canon/objects/text/messaging.md): chat & bot messages — structure where color can't go

## Motion & effects
- [motion](canon/objects/text/motion/README.md): spinners (braille · arc · pulse), progress (dot-matrix · ▰▱)
- [effects](canon/effects/README.md): glass, grain, pointer, ambient — web surfaces only, on the effect.* roles

## Typography
- [typography](canon/type/README.md): warm serif display + mono (Maple · JetBrains · Geist), all OFL

## Prompts — drop-in system-prompt modules, stack on demand
- [identity](canon/prompts/identity.md): the whole language in one block
- [principles](canon/prompts/principles.md) · [palette](canon/prompts/palette.md) · [cli](canon/prompts/cli.md) · [comments](canon/prompts/comments.md) · [text](canon/prompts/text.md)
- [motion](canon/prompts/motion.md) · [effects](canon/prompts/effects.md) · [typography](canon/prompts/typography.md) · [image](canon/prompts/image.md) · [messaging](canon/prompts/messaging.md): motion, effects, fonts, images, chat in the style

## Workshop — how a component gets into the library
- [extraction](workshop/EXTRACTION.md): every component of every reference, named before it is judged
- [filters](workshop/FILTERS.md): F0…F10 in order — substance, zone, register, distinctness, proofs, craft, value
- [previews](workshop/PREVIEWS.md): the contract a rebuilt component must satisfy
- [catalogue](workshop/refs/extract/catalogue.json): 782 parts from 265 references
- [registry](canon/registry.json): every manifest in one machine index (shadcn shape: registry.json)

## Library — ready artifacts to lift
- [previews](library/previews/): 246 rebuilt components, one directory per register
- [web](library/web/README.md): the drop-in kit — palette.css + yoshiki.css, no build step
- [integrations](library/integrations/README.md): npm, Tailwind preset, Figma variables, Style Dictionary, typed tokens
- [themes](https://github.com/zinzaki/yoshiki-themes#readme): kitty · foot · alacritty · ghostty · wezterm · starship · base24 · vscode · neovim · tmux · btop · zellij · fzf (generated)
- [effects](library/effects/README.md) · [menus](library/menus/README.md) · [charts](library/charts/README.md) · [text](library/text/README.md) · [snippets](https://github.com/zinzaki/yoshiki-themes/tree/main/snippets/README.md) · [configs](https://github.com/zinzaki/yoshiki-themes/tree/main/configs/README.md) · [presets](https://github.com/zinzaki/yoshiki-themes/tree/main/presets/README.md) · [github](library/github/README.md) · [image-prompts](library/image-prompts/README.md)

## Build
- [tools/build.py](tools/build.py): bakes every theme, export and the contrast proof from `canon/palettes`
- [tools/check.py](tools/check.py): links resolve; the showcase carries no palette of its own
